items.information: 1競技につき500円の参加料となります。 参加費は当日入場時にお支払いください。 参加者が申込数が定員の200名に達した場合、すでに申し込みをしているのに競技者一覧に表示されていない方はキャンセル待ちとなります。キャンセル待ちの繰上げは11月20日（月）まで行いますので、もし都合がつかずキャンセルされる場合は、なるべくお早めにご連絡いただけますようお願いいたします。 500 Yen for each additional event. We accept payment only with cash at the entrance. In case competitors are over 200, you will be placed on waiting list. If a competitor cancels until 20 Nov, we will register the person who is on the top of the waiting list. If you will not participate this competition, please tell us.

items.name: Liberty Science Center Open 2017

venue.name: [Liberty Science Center](http://www.lsc.org/)
venue.address: 222 Jersey City Blvd, Jersey City, New Jersey 07305

items.information: The registration fee is $30 and includes admission into the science center. There is a maximum of 120 competitors for this competition. Pre-registration and pre-payment is required to compete. Walk-ins will not be permitted to compete and there will be no waitlist for this competition--once the competitor limit is reached, registration will be closed. Spectators will need to purchase tickets for admission to the science center. Ticket information is available at [LSC's website](https://lsc.org/buy-tickets), but tickets may be purchased on-site. This is a CubingUSA supported competition.

items.name: Swiss Nationals 2017

venue.name: [Swiss Science Center](http://www.technorama.ch/)

items.information: Der Veranstaltungsort öffnet erst um 10 Uhr, jedoch werden Teilnehmer und Gäste vorher schon hineingelassen. Jedermann ist für den Zuttrit zu den Swiss Nationals berechtigt, jedoch können nur Schweizer Preise gewinnen. Der Eintritt zum Technorama ist inbegriffen. ___________________________________________ The venue opens only at 10 am, but competitors and attendants will be allowed to enter beforehand. Swiss Nationals is open to citizens from all countries, but only Swiss citizens are eligible to win trophies. Entry to the Science Center is included for registered guests and competitors. ___________________________________________ Le musée dans lequel a lieu la compétition ouvre seulement à 10 heures, cependant les compétiteurs et accompagnants pourront accéder à la salle plus tôt. Toute personne est autorisée à participer, mais les récompenses ne seront distribuées qu'aux compétiteurs de nationalité suisse.
